title: Hedge Desk Basis Note: Working a Pricing Instruction on Grain Marketing Contracts
content:
Pricing under Grain Marketing Contracts moves bushels out of the unpriced position at a fixed level and is worked only on a written instruction.

**The instruction.** A signed pricing instruction for those bushels is registered with the grain desk before the bushels are priced, and an instruction the member has lodged but not signed is held rather than worked, however plainly they confirm it on the telephone. Whether an instruction is signed, and what standing it carries, is read off the instruction record itself, against the instruction reference.

**The outside limit.** Bushels standing in the member's unpriced position are priced no later than the maximum carry period running from the day the bushels entered the member's unpriced position; the maximum carry period is counted in whole calendar days from the position date, the position date itself counting as day zero, and the final day of the period is itself still timely. The position date and the pricing standing are read off the member's own records against the pricing reference on the parcel.

*Boundary.* On a programme carrying a maximum carry period of 180 calendar days, a parcel that took its position on the anchor day is still timely when priced on the one hundred and eightieth day after that anchor, the anchor day itself counting as day zero. Priced on the day after that, it is out of time.

**What happens to a parcel left standing.** A parcel still unpriced after that is priced by the elevator at the close of the final day at the posted bid, and the member is notified rather than asked.

**Cutoff and trading days.** Instructions registered before the programme's daily cutoff time are worked the same trading day and those after it on the next trading day, the cutoff being read on the elevator's local clock, and a day on which the futures market does not trade is not a trading day at all.

**Parcel size and daily count.** An instruction must name at least the programme's minimum increment, and the desk works no more than the programme's daily maximum for one member; instructions beyond that are carried to the next trading day in the order they were registered.

**Channel.** Only the channels the programme opens may be used, so a member whose programme has no online pricing cannot self-price in the portal however the portal behaves.

**The level.** The flat price is the futures level captured plus the basis carried on the parcel, and where the programme carries a price floor the floor premium has already been charged and the settlement price is the better of the floor and the captured level.
